{{Historical content|The boss is removed from the game in version 3.30.0}} {{MonsterBox | name = {{PAGENAME}} | rarity = Boss | image = | level = | location = [[Apex of Atzoatl]] of [[The Temple of Atzoatl]] | quest = | resistance = Resists [[Elemental Damage]]

{{moncat|construct}}[[Construct]] | skill = | aura = | metadata_id = Metadata/Monsters/LeagueIncursion/VaalSaucerBoss }} [[File:The Vaal Omnitect promo.png|right|thumb|300px|Promo image of the monster]] {{status | name = Omnitect's Thruster | type = Debuff | description = You are taking more damage from the Omnitect's thruster the longer you stand underneath it. }} {{status | name = Omnitect's Paralysis | type = Debuff | icon = Screech status icon.png | description = You have less Movement Speed and take increase Lightning Damage }} '''The Vaal Omnitect''' was the final boss of the [[Temple of Atzoatl]], located in its topmost room. ==Entry== ===The Temple of Atzoatl=== To challenge The Vaal Omnitect players need to complete 12 temporal incursions, which [[Alva, Master Explorer]] will offer in [[Area|areas]] or [[Map|maps]]. The topmost room needs either to be connected to the [[Incursion room|room]] on the bottom of the pyramid or players must make use of {{il|Flashpowder Keg}} from an [[Explosives Room]]. ==Abilities== The Vaal Omnitect has several different [[Active skill|skill]]s. Each of its four heads attack autonomously. * Laser blast - Marks several spots on the ground with a red laser, which all detonate afterwards. * Lightning beam - Channels multiple lasers that deal lightning damage in small areas. * Explosive flare - Fires balls of fire that explode and split into smaller fire projectiles in a [[nova]]. * Summon Phantasms - Fires a ball that spawn into Phantasms, which chase the player and detonate for lightning damage on contact. * Thrusters - Standing too close to the Omnitect applies a stacking debuff that deals Physical Damage over Time, ramping up the longer you stand near it. At ~75% and 25% health, it will charge up and use one of two attacks while also gaining damage reduction for the attack. * Flamethrowers - Spews four perpendicular rows of fire. Touching it deals large amounts of fire damage periodically. The Omnitect will move around and rotate occasionally. * Lightning Wave - Launches multiple slow blue {{sl|id=WaveOfConviction}}. They deal heavy lightning damage on contact apply a stacking debuff known as [[Omnitect's Paralysis]], which increases Lightning Damage taken and reduces movement speed. At 50%, the Omnitect goes invincible, drops down at the center of the stage and spawns Energised Phantasms at the corners of the arena that move towards the Omnitect, restoring its Energy Shield if they touch it. These can be killed and they provide [[flask]] charges. The Vaal Omnitect can be augmented by upgrading specific [[incursion room]]s : * [[Lightning Workshop]] / [[Omnitect Reactor Plant]] / [[Conduit of Lightning]] : {{c|mod|Augments the Omnitect with lightning.}} Lightning Defenses in walls are activated, sending lightning balls across the stage periodically. * [[Flame Workshop]] / [[Omnitect Forge]] / [[Crucible of Flame]] : {{c|mod|Augments the Omnitect with fire.}} Flame Turrets in the corners are activated, spewing fire periodically. * [[Hatchery]] / [[Automaton Lab]] / [[Hybridisation Chamber]] : {{c|mod|Augments the Omnitect with minions.}} Adds two [[Omnitect's Guard]]s to the fight during the Energised Phantasm stage. * [[Workshop]] / [[Engineering Department]] / [[Factory (incursion room)|Factory]]: {{c|mod|Increases the life of the Omnitect.}} Gives 15/25/35% increased Life to the Omnitect. == Drops == {{Mbox|text=Drop rates for Vaal Omnitect with item lvl >81, [[version 3.28.0]], n=1000 https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RlaQMUTpE11uP74EpPYT-q5KIZKR2ojyeUgwp0Jh5hs/;
[[version 3.24.0]]-[[version 3.27.0]], n=1151https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/11R83C1Fe88CVMWLRjlfX_IyNcPLSrhkx9HAo6pO2EXU/#gid=69235479 Actual drop rates may vary.}} Always drops one of the following items: * {{il|String of Servitude}} (1 implict) (45%) * {{il|String of Servitude}} (2 implict) (1%) * {{il|Soul Catcher}} (20%) * {{il|Sacrificial Heart}} (4%) * {{il|Tempered Flesh}} (7%) * {{il|Tempered Mind}} (7%) * {{il|Tempered Spirit}} (7%) * [[Vial]] (9%) : :* {{il|Vial of Transcendence}} (28%) :* {{il|Vial of Summoning}} (17%) :* {{il|Vial of the Ritual}} (17%) :* {{il|Vial of Fate}} (17%) :* {{il|Vial of Dominance}} (10%) :* {{il|Vial of Consequence}} (8%) :* {{il|Vial of Awakening}} (2%) :* {{il|Vial of Sacrifice}} (0.2%) :* {{il|Vial of the Ghost}} (0.2%) The rooms in the [[Temple of Atzoatl]] can also add an additional chance to drop specific types of [[Vial]]s. In addition, it can drop the following: * {{il|Chasing Risk}} (~2.5%) * {{il|Ambition}} (~7%) The Vaal Omnitect also drops rare items with an [[List_of_incursion_mods|Incursion specific modifier]], mod drop chances are affected by the rooms in the [[Temple of Atzoatl]]. ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.30.0| * Atziri has taken up residence in the Temple of Atzoatl, evicting the Vaal Omnitect and making some adjustments. * Former loots of Vaal Omnitect have the following changes: ** [[Vial]]s no longer drop. Unique items that required Vials to obtain instead now drop from various places in Temples of Atzoatl that contain a Cradle of Creation. ** The {{il|Ambition}} Unique Vaal Aspect now drops from the Trialmaster. ** {{il|Sacrificial Heart}}, {{il|Tempered Flesh}}, {{il|Tempered Mind}} and {{il|Tempered Spirit}} now drop from specific chests in the [[Glittering Halls]] Temple of Atzoatl room. ** {{il|Soul Catcher}} now has a chance to drop from specific chests in the [[Museum of Artefacts]] Temple of Atzoatl room. ** [[String of Servitude]] can be obtained from [[Ipaatiki, Vaal Priestess]] within the [[Forgotten Shrine]] Atlas Anomaly. This item always drops with 2 Implicit Modifiers. ** Removed all sources of Incursion Architect Modifiers on Magic and Rare items. * The Forsaken Masters [[achievement]] is unobtainable as it still requires The Vaal Omnitect as a bug. {{undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.22.0| * [[Stun]] Immunity has been removed from many Bosses in Path of Exile. This includes but is not limited to [[Atziri]], [[Argus]], [[The Vaal Omnitect]] and [[Immortal Syndicate|Betrayal]] Targets. Some Bosses now have specific skills that cannot be stunned, or cannot be interrupted. [[Kitava]] is still unable to be stunned. }} {{Version history table row|3.17.3b| * Updated the name of the "Lightning Exposure" debuff in the '''Vaal Omnitect''' Boss fight to "Omnitect's Paralysis", as it does not reduce Lightning Resistances. }} {{Version history table row|3.17.2| *The Vaal Omnitect and Atziri, Queen of the Vaal are now also untargetable whilst they are invulnerable, preventing Minions from prioritising them over other monsters. }} {{Version history table row|3.14.0| * Previously, the temple's boss, the Omnitect, dropped random rare items with special Incursion modifiers on them. Now, it also drops rare items with Incursion modifiers based around the themes of the rooms your temple contains, and has a higher chance to drop Vials related to that room. Having higher tier rooms also causes more rare items to drop. }} {{Version history table row|3.5.0| * Added to the core game as part of [[Master]] mission. }} {{Version history table row|3.3.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} == References == {{Navbox Incursion}} {{Navbox Bestiary}} [[Category:Map bosses]]
